content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary (ASSIGN — deviation, preferred target):**

- **Core clause:** § 13.4.1 (p0648) — mutual consent requirement (not unreasonably withheld/conditioned/delayed) with a *mutual* no-consent carve-out for Affiliates and successors.
- **Customer-favourable already:** we may assign to an Affiliate or merger/stock/asset successor without Harpoon's consent; § 13.2 Change in Control provisions run only against Harpoon and give us rights (JGC disbandment, information cut-off under 5.8.2) — not flagged.
- **Gap:** the same carve-out lets Harpoon assign to any Affiliate or successor — potentially a competitor-controlled acquirer — with no consent and no competitor bar; this fails preferred elements 3 and 5 and does not sit at fallback either (no notice mechanic, and the affiliate exception conflicts with "other assignments require consent"). Fixing to fallback would have required stripping our own affiliate right, so we targeted preferred.
- **Redline (validated, minimal):** limits the no-consent exception to AbbVie and adds "in no event shall Harpoon assign this Agreement to a Competitor," preserving the reasonableness standard, affiliate-responsibility, void-assignment, binding-effect and assumption mechanics verbatim.
